front.title: PCEP Extensions for Conditional Recovery Admission and Coordination

abstract.t:
Following a disruptive event, multiple Path Computation Element (PCE)-controlled Label Switched Paths (LSPs) may need to recover over the same limited remaining resources. Individually feasible paths do not necessarily remain feasible when competing recovery updates are activated concurrently.
This document proposes PCEP extensions to carry explicit conditional recovery admission decisions, correlate their installation outcomes, and reconcile their admission state after failures or PCEP session loss. Coordination is limited to consistent accounting of shared recovery resources by one active stateful PCE.
The extension does not specify path computation algorithms, guarantee end-to-end service performance, or replace local fast protection.
